name: ms-SWIFT
summary: ModelScope SWIFT toolkit for training, fine-tuning, deploying and evaluating 100+ LLMs and multimodal models (Apache-2.0).
description: Established Apache-2.0 toolkit (modelscope/ms-swift; not archived; not a 2026 launch). PyPI ms-swift 4.6.0 and English docs https://swift.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ verified 2026-11-11. Install with pip install ms-swift. Covers fine-tuning and related post-training / deployment workflows documented upstream. Model licenses, GPUs and any ModelScope or cloud hosting are separate.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install ms-swift.
